bench_requirements.type: CK-001 project requirement, not an external standard
bench_requirements.procedure: Build material/process-matched riser coupons and determine minimum strip/pull-out torque across the sample lot before setting assembly torque.
bench_requirements.acceptance_rule: Assembly torque must be derived from observed strip data with an owner-approved safety margin and must not exceed the applicable screw manufacturer's limit. No numeric assembly torque is released by C02.

bench_requirements.type: CK-001 project screening requirement, not an external standard
bench_requirements.procedure: On physical PEC11R shaft/knob/set-screw assemblies record applied set-screw torque, then perform 10 N axial pull for 10 s and 0.05 N m torsional hold for 10 s.
bench_requirements.acceptance_rule: No release until owner accepts measured slip/damage data; initial screening target is no visible damage and no more than 0.2 mm axial or 2 degree rotational slip.

bench_requirements.type: CK-001 project screening requirement, not an external standard
bench_requirements.procedure: Apply 5 N in each principal direction for 10 s to each material/process-matched daughterboard clamp assembly while monitoring board movement and fastener damage.
bench_requirements.acceptance_rule: Initial screening target: no visible damage and no more than 0.2 mm permanent board shift; electrical continuity must be tested separately.

bench_requirements.type: CK-001 project screening requirement, not an external standard
bench_requirements.procedure: Measure real KS-33 housing opening and keycap boss, record insertion/removal force, and cycle cap insertion/removal 50 times. Measure each real switch's actual bottom-out and verify no premature cap/housing contact within the manufacturer's 2.8..3.2 mm total-travel range. Separately use a 3.2 mm mechanical tolerance gauge with the switch removed to prove fixture/cap clearance; do not force a factory actuator beyond its own hard stop.
bench_requirements.acceptance_rule: No manufacture release until sampled physical dimensions and real-switch bottom-out measurements support positive clearance and the owner accepts retention-force distribution; 5 N axial pull for 10 s is an initial screening target only.

bench_requirements.type: CK-001 project requirement, not an external standard
bench_requirements.procedure: Machine/print first articles using the selected production-intent materials and record bore, cylindrical counterbore, post OD, thread quality, surface condition and assembly fit.
bench_requirements.acceptance_rule: Digital topology or nominal CAD dimensions cannot substitute for first-article measurement.
